description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM and a baseline Vanilla model. The x-axis represents TFLOPs, with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, and tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio in percentage, with a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, and tick labels at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. The plot includes five lines: Vanilla (purple, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid, no markers), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid, circle markers). The Vanilla line remains steady at 100% across the x-axis. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at around 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to approximately 100% at 3e8 TFLOPs before slightly decreasing to around 99.6% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at about 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to nearly 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, then gradually decreases to around 98.6% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at approximately 97% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to around 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, remaining relatively stable before slightly decreasing to about 99.4% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line begins at around 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to approximately 98.7% at 3e8 TFLOPs, then gradually increases to around 98.8% at 6e8 TFLOPs before slightly decreasing to about 98.5% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
